user.title: Connect to Smart Home Solutions
user.description: Generate a pairing code on your Account page in the SHS customer portal, then enter it here within 10 minutes.

error.invalid_pairing_code: The pairing code was not accepted. Codes are single-use and expire after 10 minutes — generate a new one in the portal.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Smart Home Solutions server.

init.title: Energy planning
init.description: Automatic setup reads the aggregate meters already curated in your Energy Dashboard, then shows what it found before anything is treated as controllable. Promotional examples live only on the website and never enter Home Assistant or customer storage.

data.entities_heating: Heating (radiators, floor heating, heat pump heating)
data.grid_export_power_entity: Live grid export power entity (reactive surplus)
data.battery_target_is_hard: Treat battery target as a hard constraint
data.battery_export_enabled: Allow planned battery export at high prices
data.battery_export_min_price_sek_per_kwh: Minimum export price for battery discharge (SEK/kWh)
data.terminal_soc_min: Minimum SOC at the end of the horizon

metering.title: Whole-home meters
metering.description: Select aggregate energy meters only. Do not add phase-level children when an aggregate meter exists.

data.entities_total_consumption: Total home consumption (optional when it can be derived)

categories.title: Energy categories
categories.description: These mappings support reporting. A mapped category is not assumed to be controllable.

forecasts.title: Solar and weather forecasts
forecasts.description: Supplier prices are configured and calculated on the Smart Home Solutions website. Solar is optional. The outdoor temperature sensor and weather entity feed thermal-zone learning; without them heating stays electrically planned but thermally unmodelled.

data.weather_forecast_entity: Weather entity for the outdoor forecast

battery.title: Battery and grid limits
battery.description: Leave the battery entity and ratings empty for homes without a battery. Planned battery export is advisory and disabled by default; when enabled it never deliberately exports below the configured reserve.

data.battery_target_is_hard: Make the battery target a hard reservation
data.battery_export_enabled: Allow planned battery export at high prices
data.battery_export_reserve_soc: Do not deliberately export below this SOC

ev.title: EV planning
ev.description: The charge-current entity supplies its raw bounds. The planner uses three 230 V phases and derives usable capacity from live SOC and remaining energy. Departure is optional; without it the planner works toward the car's charge limit over the rolling horizon.

device_controls.title: Website-requested device controls
device_controls.description: Device {position} of {total}: **{device_name}** requests **{control_type}** control. Mapping status: **{mapping_status}**. Choose a device action or finish and save. Devices without a complete mapping remain part of base load.

error.website_configuration_unavailable: Could not fetch the latest website device selections. Try Configure again; no Home Assistant restart is required.
error.invalid_device_mapping: The mapping is incomplete. Provide the required entities for this control type.

missing_customer_input.title: Home profile answer required

subscription_inactive.title: Smart Home Solutions subscription inactive
subscription_inactive.description: Your SHS subscription is no longer active, so energy data is not being pushed to your energy history. Renew the subscription in the customer portal to resume.

optimisation_configuration.title: Energy planning inputs required

device_control_mapping.title: Controllable devices need configuration

unplanned_service.title: A service is configured but not being planned

optimisation_plan_refused.title: Energy plan refused by Home Assistant
